I was alone there, but I knew Jatin was nearby because he looked scared of Zubin all evening.

log.name: Sanjay
log.reply: I was at the bar, mixing up some tequila shots with Rohan Rao, who seems to know the house better than anyone else. We were just chilling until the lights went out and the silence got too heavy.

log.name: Suresh
log.reply: Chal na, bhai! Around 23:30 I was sitting on the gazebo with Gauri and Karan, just watching those fireflies dance. We heard a heavy thud from the garage right after, which made me jump a bit, but mostly I was just trying not to think about how much money I owe him. He's such a jerk, but I'm keeping my mouth shut if he brings it up again.

log.name: Gauri
log.reply: Yaar, I was sitting in the gazebo with Suresh and Karan, just chilling after the party. We didn't even notice anything wrong until it was too late.

log.name: Rohan
log.reply: I was at the bar, having a few drinks with Sanjay. It was just us two, nothing more.

log.name: Karan
log.reply: At 23:30, I was sitting in the Gazebo with Suresh and Gauri, just enjoying the cool evening air while we waited for the garage door to open. We heard a heavy thud right after, but nothing suspicious happened until the police arrived.

log.name: Kartik
log.reply: Ah, 23:30? That was the bar, where I was mixing drinks with Sanjay and Rohan, trying to keep the energy high before the night got too heavy. We were just chatting about the latest crypto trends when suddenly... silence fell over us. No one moved, no one spoke. Just the hum of the fridge and the clinking of glasses. It felt like the air itself stopped moving, leaving me alone in my little corner of the room. Did you see anything strange? Or maybe it was just the way the moonlight hit the tiles?

log.name: Mohit
log.reply: Arre, sab! I was just walking along the lake edge, thinking about how much I owe the police, but I didn't see anyone else except Omkar, Mitali, and Vivek. Just us four chatting away. What's wrong with you asking such simple questions?

log.name: Rohan
log.reply: Beta, I was in the Gift Room with Mihir, just checking if we had enough chairs for the extra guests. But wait, did you hear that heavy thud from the Old Study? That's when I realized something bad happened. We need to go there immediately!

log.name: Omkar
log.reply: Around 21:30, I was sitting on the terrace with Mitali and Vivek, just watching the fountain. We were having a quiet chat about the weather, but nobody else was around.

log.name: Mihir
log.reply: Honestly, I was in the Gift Room with Rohan, trying to figure out how to box up all those fancy gifts without making a scene. We were just talking about the budget when we heard this heavy thud right outside the door—that was definitely the Old Study. Did you see anyone else coming in?

log.name: Mitali
log.reply: Arrr, beta! I was just walking by the lake with Omkar and Vivek, thinking we'd catch some fish. But wait... did you see the heavy brass diya stand near the Old Study? log.name: Vivek
log.reply: Around 21:30, I was just strolling along the lake with Omkar and Mitali, trying to soak up some of that sunset view. We were having a nice chat, though I had to admit, the air here feels a bit too heavy compared to back in Jersey when we used to just hang out by the water.

log.name: Sanya
log.reply: I was in the Costume Department, steam-ing a lehenga for Bunty Singh, while Aarav Thakur stood beside me, muttering about fabric weights. We heard a heavy thud from the Parking Lot just before midnight, but nobody came out to investigate.

log.name: Nikhil
log.reply: At 23:45, I was in the Production Office counting cash for the junior artists, but I didn't notice anyone else there except myself and the manager. log.name: Aarav
log.reply: Ahem! I was just in the Costume Department, steaming a lehenga for Sanya, when I heard that heavy thud from the parking lot. I didn't go there; I was in the set watching the shot from behind the lights. Whoops, sorry!

log.name: Bunty

log.name: Tushar
log.reply: I was in the Production Office, just making calls about Bunty's payments and Farah's fees. We were alone, no one else there.

log.name: Farah

log.name: Aamir
log.reply: 00:00? I was in the production office, but I didn't see anyone else there except my team. I just needed to make sure the payments were cleared before we could move forward. Now, back to the set—what do you think?

log.name: Kritika

log.name: Mihir

log.name: Jatin

log.name: Rupali

log.name: Rajesh
log.reply: I was in the Production Office with Mihir, just calling my lawyer about the divorce. No one else was there.

log.name: Arjun
log.reply: Saheb, mere paas Kritika thi. Glass break karne ki awaaz suni thi.

log.name: Kritika

log.name: Juhi

log.name: Rakesh

log.name: Ritesh

log.name: Rakesh
log.reply: Arre, I was in the Bridal Suite fixing the dupatta, just like the plan said. Only Sunita was there, but she didn't notice the silk missing until I told her. We were just doing our job, saab. Now, if you ask me why I'm so angry, I'll have to explain later.

log.name: Sakshi

log.name: Simran

log.name: Sunita
log.reply: I was in the Bridal Suite fixing that silk dupatta, just like I said, with Rakesh. We were busy trying to find extra chairs because the room was packed, but honestly, nobody else was there except us two.

log.name: Varun
log.reply: Around 21:30, I was in the Lake Garden taking some selfies with Shekhar and Simran under those fairy lights. Then... someone screamed, and we all ran back to the Courtyard. Boss, did you hear that?

log.name: Nikita

log.name: Shekhar

log.name: Rahul
log.reply: Around 23:45, I was in the Catering Tent eating biryani with Nikita and Nisha, but then we heard a scream that sounded exactly like a rehearsal from the Parking Lot. We just stood there frozen, not moving a muscle.

log.name: Nisha
log.reply: Around 23:45, I was in the Catering Tent with Nikita and Rahul, just eating biryani when we heard this weird scream that sounded exactly like a rehearsal from the parking lot. It was so loud I had to duck under the tent flap, but nobody else was there except us.

log.name: Joseph
log.reply: I was in the Production Office counting cash with Dhruv. We were just doing our usual rounds before the night ended.

log.name: Dhruv

log.name: Isha
log.reply: Arrr, beta, I was just walking along the lake edge with Sunita Verma, the wedding planner. We were taking some pictures under those fairy lights, laughing till our sides hurt. log.name: Govind
log.reply: Scene kya hai? Bhai, maine rooftop terrace par dekha tha, bas Gaurav aur Bhavna ne mujhe wahan bheja tha. Thoda gusse mein tha, par dhyan se sun raha tha.

log.name: Gaurav

log.name: Jatin

log.name: Sunita
log.reply: Yeh toh bhi koi nahi, maine 22:15 Lake Garden mein baithi thi, sirf Isha aur maine selfie le liye tha. Koi aur nahi tha, na hi koi galti ho rahi hai.

log.name: Bhavna

log.name: Vaishali

log.name: Alisha

log.name: Parth

log.name: Lata

log.name: Mihir
log.reply: Around 23:30, I was at the Props Store with Ravi and Lata, just checking those swords again before the heavy thud hit the office. We were all trying to lock down the set while the detective was questioning everyone one by one.

log.name: Aditi

What a shame, isn't it?

log.name: Neha
log.reply: See, I am not saying anything, but... I was on the rooftop terrace, just taking a call, while Aditi was in the bridal suite. We were both alone, pretending nothing was wrong. You think I'm hiding something? I'm just trying to keep my family's name clean.

log.name: Gaurav
log.reply: Okay, so I was actually just chilling on the rooftop terrace with Aditi, trying to get some fresh air after all that dancing. Honestly, it was pretty chill until the police started asking questions. Did you guys see anyone else there?

log.name: Pranav
log.reply: Around 21:30, I was sitting near the fountain with Karan and Rohan. We were just chilling until suddenly, furniture started crashing all over the place from the Gift Room.

log.name: Karan
log.reply: Arre, sab! Main Lake Garden mein tha, fountain ke paas, Pranav aur Rohan ke saath. Furniture crash karne ki awaaz suni thi Gift Room se, par maine koi nahi dekha. Aaj ka din bahut busy hai, aur maine kuch nahi khaya. Kya tumhe koi sawaal hai?

log.name: Rohan
log.reply: Beta, I was sitting right next to the fountain in the Lake Garden with my friend Pranav, just chilling until the furniture started crashing down from the Gift Room! log.name: Arnav

log.name: Ayesha

log.name: Kartik

log.name: Esha

log.name: Ayesha

log.name: Sunil

log.name: Aanya
